sources.title: Semi-implicit scheme for treating radiation under M1 closure in general relativistic conservative fluid dynamics codes
sources.adopted: Local conservative source equations and backward-Euler endpoint four-force, with opposite matter/radiation increments and algebraic conservation reduction.
sources.conventions: c=1; mixed-index T^t_t has the opposite sign to positive Minkowski lab energy. Rest mass rho is a mass density.
sources.exclusions: M1/grey/Planck force closure and approximate failsafe are not current H/He assumptions. Section3.3 admits Newton failure; no coupled-stage global uniqueness or unconditional positivity theorem.

sources.title: High-order accurate physical-constraints-preserving finite difference WENO schemes for special relativistic hydrodynamics
sources.adopted: For c=1, fixed gamma-law EOS with 1<Gamma<=2, strict admissible conserved-state characterization and unique positive physical pressure via a monotone unsquared scalar equation.
sources.conventions: D is lab rest-mass density; total E includes rest energy; p>0 is strict.
sources.exclusions: No photon/chemistry coupling; no proof that an arbitrary conservative source increment remains admissible; no cold-boundary or arbitrary-Newton convergence claim.
sources.project_mapping_status: At fixed composition, positive rest energy per H r gives the energy-unit replacement D_paper -> D_H*r. This is a project interpretation, not a quotation from the paper.
